infobox.usage: Unlocks room 314 (Marked room) in the three story dorms on Customs.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Dorm room 314 marked key (Dorm 314) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A dormitory room 314 key with strange symbols scratched onto it where the room label would normally be. The key has completely rusted through, making it very fragile.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Players who completed the Wild Wild Woods event quest have a barter option for this key on Jaeger LL4, requiring 25× Silver Badge.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text:
- Used in the story chapter They Are Already Here when you don't have any of the other marked keys
- Used in the story chapter The Ticket

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Customs
sections.text: - In a key cabinet at the dorm guard desk that is located at the two-story dorms

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Door to room 314 (Marked room) on the third floor of the three-story dorms building on Customs.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text: - Loose loot (multiple very rare Valuables, Weapons, Containers, Currency, Keycards)
